[SWS_CM_00814] Callback handling after
StopOfferService
⌈
No callback shall
be invoked after the call to
StopOfferService()
has completed, if a callback is
executed when
StopOfferService()
is called,
StopOfferService()
shall block
until the callback has finished.
⌋
